# Pull Request

## What does this change?

## Why?

Link the issue, discussion, or RFC this relates to.

## Type

- [ ] Docs fix (typo, clarification, no meaning change)
- [ ] Design change (requires issue or discussion first)
- [ ] RFC proposal (follows RFC_PROCESS.md)
- [ ] Chore (templates, CI, repo hygiene)

## Checklist

- [ ] I have read CONTRIBUTING.md
- [ ] My commits are signed off (`git commit -s`, DCO)
- [ ] Docs updated in the same PR where relevant
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated for user-facing changes
